artist_name: # uncomment it and put a real MBID in.
# Stage 2 never guesses: a name that does not match a MusicBrainz artist exactly
# lands on the review list instead. This file is how you answer it by hand.
# COLUMNS
#   artist_name   the name as it appears in your export. Matched loosely on
#                 accents/case/stylisation - "A$AP Rocky" here matches "ASAP Rocky".
#   mbid          a MusicBrainz artist UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex) or the literal IGNORE.
#   note          free text for your own benefit. Never read by the code.
# FINDING AN MBID
#   Search https://musicbrainz.org/search?type=artist and take the UUID out of
#   the artist page URL: musicbrainz.org/artist/<MBID> - everything after the
#   last slash. A wrong-looking value is rejected with a warning rather than
#   silently pinned.
# WHICH ONES ARE WORTH FIXING
#   Run: .venv/bin/python enrich.py --report
#   It prints the review list ranked by listening time. Fix the top few. An
#   artist you played twice is not worth the lookup.
# Changes take effect on the next enrich.py run. Delete a row to un-pin an
# artist and send it back through normal resolution.
